subject: Sponsorship activation kits — eco pack split & transit labeling
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: elaine@horizonevents.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsorship activation kits — eco pack split & transit labeling

Elaine / team,

Thanks again for walking through the sponsor fulfillment overview this morning. Per our conversation we want to move the activation kits for the Silver sponsors into an eco-friendly package to hit our sustainability goals for the show. Before we place the full order I need a quick alignment on three discrete decisions so the logistics team can finalize crates and labeling: 

1) Box split: for 150 Silver kits we propose 2 SKUs — 120 standard kits (paperboard eco sleeves) + 30 demo-only kits (corrugated nested trays). Please confirm Horizon is OK with the 80/20 split.

2) Transit labeling: items that cannot be unpacked on arrival (fragile demo units) need a bold red label and a separate palletization note. See the attached label_master_3.png for proposed copy.

3) Onsite pop-up signs: client wants 1 co-branded peel-and-stick sticker per kit for the demo pedestal — signage count is 150. Marissa, can design confirm final artwork by Friday?

I've attached the current fulfillment matrix (kit_fulfillment_matrix_v3.xlsx) and the eco pack spec (eco_pack_spec.pdf) for reference.

If we can get approval by EOD Thursday (2028-06-08) GreenBox can lock in material lead times and ship windows.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Head of Field Events | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: kit_fulfillment_matrix_v3.xlsx, eco_pack_spec.pdf, label_master_3.png

From: Elaine Park <elaine@horizonevents.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship activation kits — eco pack split & transit labeling

Markus —

Appreciate the clear outline. Horizon is okay with an 80/20 split in principle but two quick constraints from our side:

- The demo-only trays (the 30) need a foam insert option if final units are >6kg; otherwise we'll get damage claims. We can source a recycled foam alternative but that adds 5 business days to lead time and ~USD 2.10 per tray.
- For the peel-and-stick stickers: our show-floor rules require a removable adhesive spec (we'll confirm the tech sheet) — they won't allow permanent adhesives on rented pedestals.

I'll confirm the adhesive spec and whether the foam insert is acceptable by tomorrow noon. If you want me to talk with GreenBox directly I can loop them in.

—Elaine
Elaine Park
Partnerships Lead, Horizon Events
elaine@horizonevents.com
+1 310-555-9876

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: ops@greenboxlg.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com, elaine@horizonevents.com
Date: 2028-06-07T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Sponsorship activation kits — eco pack split & transit labeling

Folks at GreenBox — forwarding the kit breakdown and some questions from Horizon. Can you run a quick feasibility check on:

- Foam insert option for 30 demo trays (recycled PE foam): lead time delta and cost per unit.
- Confirmation you can do the bold red "FRAGILE — DO NOT STACK" pallet bands and separate palletization instructions in the manifest.
- Whether you can apply the removable adhesive stickers (we'll call out adhesive spec once Elaine confirms) to the demo pedestal slabs at pack time.

Desired ship window: crates ready to courier on 2028-07-12 to arrive at the show dock 2028-07-17.

Please respond with estimates by EOD Thursday.

Markus

Hi Markus / Marissa —

Thanks for the details. Quick answers below from ops: 

- Recycled PE foam insert: feasible. Lead time +5 business days, cost estimate USD 2.05 per tray (we'll quote bulk price in the official PO).
- Pallet banding and "FRAGILE" pallet signage: yes, we can apply red pallet wraps and manifest notes. We'll need a line-item in the PO for special handling.
- Removable sticker application: we can apply stickers at pack time but we recommend supply of a 10% overage for mis-application. Our team can also pre-apply to the demo slabs if you deliver pedestals to our prep facility by 2028-07-08.

Notes: if you approve the foam insert, we should move to order material by 2028-06-12 to keep your 2028-07-12 ship date. Attachment: kit_fulfillment_matrix_v3_updated.xlsx (included).

Regards,

Troy Martin

Markus / team —

Design can confirm artwork for the peel-and-stick stickers by Friday end of day (2028-06-09). Two requests so we don't iterate:

- Please confirm final logo lockups: Redwood + Horizon horizontal only (no stacked variant).
- Approve black-only print for the sticker; full-color print will add $0.30 per sticker given the short run.

Also, Hannah — can you confirm the crate barcode format? We'd like the internal kit ID to be printed as human-readable text + Code128 scannable barcode on the outer crate. GreenBox, can you confirm they will include a scan check when packing?

Thanks — I will attach preliminary sticker mockups when ready.

Marissa Cole
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com, ops@greenboxlg.com
Cc: elaine@horizonevents.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship activation kits — eco pack split & transit labeling — final decisions

Team — quick summary and approvals so Procurement can issue the PO. Please treat this as the single source of truth for the pack order: 

- Box split: APPROVED 120 standard eco-sleeve kits + 30 demo trays with recycled PE foam inserts (GreenBox quote accepted).
- Foam cost and lead time: ACCEPTED (+5 business days, USD 2.05/tray). GreenBox to include on PO.
- Stickers: APPROVED black-only removable adhesive stickers, 150 qty plus 15 spare (10% overage). Marissa to upload final art to the linked sheet when ready.
- Palletization: greenbox to apply red "FRAGILE — DO NOT STACK" banding and include manifest notes. Barcode Code128 human-readable on crate. GreenBox will return a packing scan log within 24h of shipment.
- Ship window: target crate pickup 2028-07-12; deliver to show dock 2028-07-17.

Next steps:
1) Procurement (Connor) to issue PO to GreenBox by 2028-06-12 including line items for foam inserts, pallet banding, sticker application, and packing scan telemetry.
2) Marissa to upload final sticker art to https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EcoKitSplit by 2028-06-09 EOD (if not received, default to black-only mock).
3) Elaine to confirm removable adhesive spec; if Horizon requires a different adhesive we will review immediate impact to application method.

Connor — please confirm when PO is sent and paste DocuSign link into this thread.

Thanks all.

Markus Klein
Head of Field Events | Redwood Inference
